import re
import sys

values = {}
assignment = re.compile(r"\b([A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*<-\s*([A-Za-z_]\w*|\d+)")

for match in assignment.finditer(sys.stdin.read()):
    name, rhs = match.groups()
    values[name] = values[rhs] if rhs.isidentifier() else int(rhs)

order = ["a", "b", "c", "d", "e", "f", "g", "h", "TMP"]
print("; ".join(f"{name} ?= {values[name]}" for name in order) + ";")
